risk_summary: The excerpt presents substantial operating and financial risks, including falling oil and gas prices, reduced customer activity, segment revenue declines, asset impairments, a $169.7 million net loss, elevated debt, and significant decommissioning obligations. Although many financing and operating figures are quantified, forward-looking claims about synergies, distributions, and future cash flows remain uncertain, while Maritech abandonment costs are difficult to estimate and may increase materially.
